title: 水资源压力
summary: 评估公司运营的水强度、运营区域的水压力水平及管理能力。

sections.title_en: Introduction
sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Water Stress Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSCI S&C’s)1 outputs are determined. Water Stress is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the water intensity of their operations, the water stress in their areas of operations, and their efforts to manage water-related risks.
blocks.content_cn: 本文介绍水资源压力关键议题的组成部分，帮助ESG评级使用者了解MSCI可持续发展与气候部门（MSCI S&C）1如何确定其研究输出。水资源压力是MSCI ESG评级模型环境支柱下的一项关键议题。对公司的评估涵盖其运营的用水强度、运营所在地区的水资源压力，以及管理水相关风险的举措。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于MSCI ESG评级模型的更多细节，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"数据、评级和分数"部分。

sections.title_en: Risks associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: • Operational disruptions to production processes requiring water as a critical input.
blocks.content_cn: • 将水作为关键投入的生产流程发生运营中断。

blocks.content: • Loss of access to markets through community opposition and heightened regulatory hurdles.
blocks.content_cn: • 因社区反对及监管门槛提高而丧失市场准入。

blocks.content: • Increased costs to comply with more stringent regulations and install equipment and systems to reduce water use.
blocks.content_cn: • 为遵守更严格的法规以及安装节水设备和系统而增加的成本。

blocks.content: • Higher water use costs.
blocks.content_cn: • 用水成本上升。

sections.title_en: Water Stress Key Issue score
sections.title_cn: 水资源压力关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Water Stress Key Issue score evaluates the company’s level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue score.
blocks.content_cn: 水资源压力关键议题得分评估公司对该议题风险的敞口程度及管理情况。该关键议题得分根据下述公式，基于风险敞口得分和管理得分计算。两项得分的结合方式意味着：风险敞口越高，公司就需要展现越强的管理能力，才能取得相同的总体关键议题得分。

sections.title_en: Water Stress Management framework
sections.title_cn: 水资源压力管理框架

blocks.content: The table below outlines the indicators mapped to their respective components that inform the Water Stress Management score, excluding controversies. MSCI S&C assigns each indicator a default weight. Indicator weights may be adjusted at the company level to reflect the relevance of the indicator to the company’s business activities. If a company has no exposure to the business activities covered by an indicator, the indicator is assigned a weight of zero.
blocks.content_cn: 下表列示了用于确定水资源压力管理得分的指标及其对应组成部分，其中不包括争议事件。MSCI S&C为各指标设定默认权重。为反映指标与公司业务活动的相关性，可在公司层面调整指标权重。如果公司对某项指标涵盖的业务活动没有风险敞口，该指标的权重设为零。

sections.title_en: Water Stress Management score
sections.title_cn: 水资源压力管理得分

blocks.content: The Water Stress Management score evaluates the company’s ability to manage its exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on weighted average of the score associated with each relevant indicators, modified by controversies.
blocks.content_cn: 水资源压力管理得分评估公司管理该议题风险敞口的能力。它基于各相关指标得分的加权平均值计算，并根据争议事件进行调整。

blocks.content: This score is derived from indicators that are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to best practice. Refer to the Analyzing risk management section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. Sources are company disclosures except where otherwise indicated.
blocks.content_cn: 该得分来源于按0-10分制评分的指标，10分对应最佳实践。更多细节请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"风险管理分析"部分。除特别注明外，数据来源为公司披露。

blocks.content: The definitions of the data points in each component are given below:
blocks.content_cn: 各组成部分中数据点的定义如下：

sections.title_en: Water Stress Governance & Strategy score
sections.title_cn: 水资源压力治理与战略得分

blocks.content: The Water Stress Governance & Strategy score evaluates the company’s governing body to oversee water-related risks and strategy to manage water stress in operations and value chains through water recycling, alternative water use, and other reduction programs. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 水资源压力治理与战略得分评估公司监督水相关风险的治理机构，以及通过水循环利用、替代水源和其他节水项目管理运营及价值链水资源压力的战略。该得分以0—10分表示，10分代表举措有力。

sections.title_en: • Use of alternative water
sections.title_cn: • 使用替代水源

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's use of water from non-freshwater sources. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating higher usage from non-freshwater sources.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司使用非淡水来源水资源的情况。采用0—10分制，10分表示非淡水水源的使用程度较高。

sections.title_en: ◦ Evidence of using alternative water sources
sections.title_cn: ◦ 使用替代水源的证据

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether there is evidence that the company uses some alternative water sources, but a percentage is not available. Alternative water sources include seawater, brackish water, gray water and rainwater.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：说明是否有证据表明公司使用某些替代水源，但未提供其占比。替代水源包括海水、微咸水、灰水和雨水。

blocks.content: ◦ Percentage of water use from alternative water sources.
blocks.content_cn: ◦ 来自替代水源的用水占比。

blocks.content:
Definition: The amount of water that the company obtains from alternative sources. 
Alternative water sources include seawater, brackish water, gray water, and rainwater.
blocks.content_cn:
定义：公司从替代水源获取的水量。
替代水源包括海水、微咸水、灰水和雨水。

sections.title_en: • Scope of water reduction programs at own operations
sections.title_cn: • 自有运营节水项目的覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the extent to which the company has implemented water reduction measures at its direct operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司在直接运营中实施节水措施的程度。

sections.title_en: • Programs to reduce water use in value chains
sections.title_cn: • 减少价值链用水的项目

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the extent to which the company has implemented or supported operational programs aimed at reducing water use in its value chain.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司在其价值链中实施或支持旨在减少用水的运营项目的程度。

sections.title_en: • Water recycling rate score
sections.title_cn: • 水循环利用率得分

blocks.content:
Definition: Assesses the company's water recycling rate based on the company's reported value. 
Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating a higher recycling rate.
blocks.content_cn:
定义：根据公司报告的数值评估其水循环利用率。
采用0—10分制，10分表示循环利用率较高。

sections.title_en: ◦ Water recycling rate
sections.title_cn: ◦ 水循环利用率

blocks.content: Definition: The percentage of recycled or recirculated water of total water usage.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：循环或再循环利用水量占总用水量的比例。

sections.title_en: • Executive body responsible for water management strategy and performance
sections.title_cn: • 负责水资源管理战略及绩效的执行机构

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the governing level of water strategy and performance oversight assigned to dedicated individuals or a committee. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating CEO or board-level oversight.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估负责水资源战略及绩效监督的专门个人或委员会所处的治理层级。采用0—10分制，10分表示由首席执行官或董事会层面监督。

sections.title_en: ◦ CEO is responsible for water management strategy and performance
sections.title_cn: ◦ 首席执行官负责水资源管理战略及绩效

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the CEO is responsible for water management strategy and performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：说明首席执行官是否负责水资源管理战略及绩效。

sections.title_en: ◦ CSR or sustainability committee is responsible for water management strategy and performance
sections.title_cn: ◦ 企业社会责任或可持续发展委员会负责水资源管理战略及绩效

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether corporate social responsibility or sustainability committees are responsible for water management strategy and performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：说明企业社会责任委员会或可持续发展委员会是否负责水资源管理战略及绩效。

sections.title_en: Non-executive- or non-committee-level task force is responsible for water management strategy and performance
sections.title_cn: 非高级管理层或非委员会层级的工作组负责水资源管理战略及绩效

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether responsibility for water management strategy and performance is with a nonexecutive- or non-committee-level task force or risk officer.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：说明水资源管理战略及绩效的责任是否由非高级管理层或非委员会层级的工作组或风险负责人承担。

sections.title_en: ◦ Senior executive or executive committee is responsible for water management strategy and performance
sections.title_cn: ◦ 高级管理人员或执行委员会负责水资源管理战略及绩效

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether a senior executive or executive committee are responsible for water management strategy and performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：说明高级管理人员或执行委员会是否负责水资源管理战略及绩效。

sections.title_en: Water Stress Targets score
sections.title_cn: 水资源压力目标得分

blocks.content: The Water Stress Targets score evaluates the company’s initiatives to set and achieve water reduction targets. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong targets.
blocks.content_cn: 水资源压力目标得分评估公司制定并实现节水目标的举措。该得分以0—10分表示，10分代表目标有力。

blocks.content: The list of indicators and their sub-indicators in Water Stress Targets score are listed below:
blocks.content_cn: 水资源压力目标得分所用指标及其子指标列示如下：

sections.title_en: • Water stress target comprehensiveness
sections.title_cn: • 水资源压力目标全面性

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the extent to which a company has established measurable water-related targets that are comprehensive in operational scope. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating a quantitative target that covers all relevant segments.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司设立可衡量且全面覆盖运营范围的水相关目标的程度。采用0—10分制，10分表示定量目标覆盖所有相关业务分部。

sections.title_en: ◦ Evidence of ongoing Water Stress target
sections.title_cn: ◦ 存在进行中的水资源压力目标的证据

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has disclosed an ongoing target addressing water stress or water resource management.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：说明公司是否披露了应对水资源压力或水资源管理方面的进行中目标。

sections.title_en: ◦ Scope of ongoing Water Stress target
sections.title_cn: ◦ 进行中的水资源压力目标范围

blocks.content: Definition: Describes the scope and coverage of the company’s ongoing target related to water stress management.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：描述公司正在推进的水资源压力管理目标的范围及覆盖情况。

sections.title_en: • Water stress target progress
sections.title_cn: • 水资源压力目标进展

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward any ongoing water reduction targets or track record of progress toward historical targets. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating higher progress towards targets.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司对进行中的节水目标的推进情况，或对过往目标的进展记录。采用0—10分制，10分表示实现目标的进展较好。

sections.title_en: ◦ Status of ongoing Water Stress target
sections.title_cn: ◦ 进行中的水资源压力目标状态

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the current implementation status of the company’s ongoing target related to water stress management or reduction.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司正在推进的水资源压力管理或减少用水目标的当前实施状态。

sections.title_en: ◦ Status of historical Water Stress target
sections.title_cn: ◦ 过往水资源压力目标状态

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the achievement or completion status of the company’s historical target related to water stress management or reduction.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司过往水资源压力管理或减少用水目标的实现或完成状态。

sections.title_en: Water Stress Performance score
sections.title_cn: 水资源压力绩效得分

blocks.content: The Water Stress Performance score evaluates the company's performance on water stress metrics, including the company’s water withdrawal and/or water consumption intensities (normalized by million USD sales or a relevant unit of production), relative to its peers. It is expressed as a 0-10 score, where indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 水资源压力绩效得分评估公司相对于同业的水资源压力指标表现，包括取水强度和／或耗水强度（按每百万美元销售额或相关产量单位标准化）。采用0—10分制；原文此处缺少代表较强绩效的具体分值，待校核。

blocks.content: The following provides a non-exhaustive overview of the indicators and sub-indicators used in the assessment of the Water Stress Performance score.
blocks.content_cn: 以下为评估水资源压力绩效得分所用指标及子指标的非穷尽概览。

sections.title_en: • Freshwater consumption performance relative to peers
sections.title_cn: • 相对于同业的淡水消耗绩效

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on freshwater consumption intensity (normalized by sales and/or product), and trend in freshwater consumption intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司相对于同业的淡水消耗强度（按销售额和／或产品标准化）及淡水消耗强度趋势表现。采用0—10分制，10分表示绩效较强。

sections.title_en: ◦ Freshwater consumption intensity industry relative score
sections.title_cn: ◦ 淡水消耗强度的行业相对得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on freshwater consumption intensity (per unit of sales or output), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.

sections.title_en: Water Stress Exposure score
sections.title_cn: 水资源压力风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Water Stress Exposure score evaluates the company’s exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the average of the Business and Company-Specific Exposure scores, combined with the Geographic Exposure score. The Geographic Exposure score functions as a multiplier on the Business Exposure score, with an impact ranging from -50% to +50%. The Business Exposure score, Geographic Exposure score and Company-Specific Exposure score are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to the Analyzing risk exposure section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure score calculation:

sections.title_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分

MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score. Each business activity score is determined by the water footprint of the business activity:

blocks.content: The Water Footprint score is determined by aggregating the company-level water withdrawal or water consumption per unit of revenue at the business activity level. This indicator is scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest water intensity and 0 to the lowest water intensity.
blocks.content_cn: 水足迹得分通过在业务活动层面汇总公司单位收入的取水量或耗水量确定。该指标采用 0—10 分制，10 分对应最高用水强度，0 分对应最低用水强度。

blocks.content: The Agricultural Water Footprint score is determined by considering the volume of water required to produce a ton of product. Business activities are mapped to specific products such as cereals, oil crops, cotton fabric and tobacco. This indicator is scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest water footprint and 0 corresponding to the lowest water footprint.
blocks.content_cn: 农业水足迹得分根据生产一吨产品所需的水量确定。业务活动被映射至谷物、油料作物、棉织物和烟草等具体产品。该指标采用 0—10 分制，10 分对应最高水足迹，0 分对应最低水足迹。

blocks.content: The Geographic Segment Exposure score is determined by the baseline water stress of the region.
blocks.content_cn: 地域分部风险敞口得分由该地区的基准水资源压力确定。
